entries.title: Canonical Polynomial-Conflict CDCL Conjecture
entries.reason: Polynomially many first-UIP conflicts with a polynomially checkable Resolution trace expand to a polynomial-size general-Resolution refutation. Explicit expander-based Tseitin CNFs require exponential general-Resolution refutations, so no fixed standard CDCL policy can satisfy H048 on every CNF.
entries.salvage: A descendant must change the proof system rather than merely the policy. H063 does this by allowing parity decisions and Res(XOR) proof logging.
